description: This file defines the class 'AveragingCachePressureMonitor' which implements cache pressure monitoring for Orleans streaming subscriber framework. It calculates average cache pressure over a period and triggers logging and status change notifications based on pressure thresholds.

classes.name: AveragingCachePressureMonitor
classes.description: Implements cache pressure monitoring by computing an average based on contributions over time, raising pressure status events, and logging pressure situations.

methods.name: AveragingCachePressureMonitor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the monitor with default or specified flow control threshold, logger, and cache monitor.

methods.name: RecordCachePressureContribution
methods.description: Records a cache pressure contribution, weighting unhealthy contributions more heavily.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Determines if the cache is under pressure at the given moment, recalculating pressure as needed.

methods.name: CalculatePressure
methods.description: Computes the average cache pressure, updates pressure status, and performs logging and notifications upon status change.

methods.name: LogDebugIngestingMessagesTooFast
methods.description: Logs a debug message indicating that message ingestion is occurring too quickly, causing high cache pressure.

methods.name: LogDebugMessageIngestionIsHealthy
methods.description: Logs a debug message indicating the cache pressure is within healthy limits.
